description: "This chair is my legs -- this chair is my life," says accessibility champion Jane Velkovski, who uses a wheelchair after being diagnosed with Spinal Muscular Atrophy (SMA). With clarity and poise, he shares how his first motorized wheelchair empowered him with independence and ability -- and why assistive technology should be available to anyone who needs it. "Freedom of movement, no matter on legs or on wheels, is a human right," he says. Hosted on Acast. See acast.com/privacy for more informa…
classificationReason: Interview focused on motorized wheelchairs and the broader impact and accessibility of assistive technology.
qualityReason: Appears to be an original, substantive personal interview with an accessibility advocate.
